items.headline: $LYX Hack: 1.4M Tokens Stolen via Email Flaw
items.summary: LUKSO blames an email recovery flaw for thefts hitting ~300 accounts, with roughly 1.4 million $LYX lost. The project is retiring email recovery, but victims must still remove the attacker's key.

items.headline: $BNB Chain Sets Jenner Upgrade Date Amid Bug Warning
items.summary: BNB Chain locked in its Jenner upgrade date, but a forum post warns BEP-706 sample code could let expired quotes slip through a timing check. One to watch for $BNB ecosystem devs.

items.headline: $HYPE Ecosystem: TradeXYZ Halts Oura Pre-IPO Perp
items.summary: TradeXYZ, a Hyperliquid HIP-3 deployer, will halt its Oura pre-IPO perpetual on Dec. 1, settling open positions at a TWAP. A key moment for pre-IPO perp markets in the $HYPE ecosystem.

items.headline: $XSGD Issuer Joins Tokenized Deposit Trial
items.summary: Standard Chartered, StraitsX and OCBC completed a tokenized deposit interoperability trial in Singapore, a step toward always-on institutional DeFi rails involving the $XSGD issuer.

items.headline: $BTC Lightning: pi402 Lets AI Agents Pay
items.summary: Lightning Labs' pi402 lets coding agents buy prepaid token bundles over Lightning, with a mainnet endpoint already advertising DeepSeek inference. A fresh DeFi-adjacent use case for $BTC.
